description: Hi everyone! We are a core team of tech enthusiasts and builders coming straight from UAI Club. As an AI-focused crew, we combine deep technical execution with creative product thinking to solve complex real-world problems. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are tackling Challenge #12: Planet X and SPHEREx—building an interactive cosmic transient hunter that transforms NASA's infrared sky maps into an engaging web app where anyone can discover moving celestial bodies!
summary:
Astraea is an interactive, web-based celestial exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to address the complexity of analyzing massive multi-epoch infrared observation data from NASA’s SPHEREx mission.

What we developed:
We built an immersive celestial atlas featuring two core modes: an artistic, narrative-driven Explorer Mode inspired by cultural motifs and the wonders of space, and a technical Research Mode that unpacks 102-band spectral analysis, Coordinate tracking (RA/DEC), and multi-extension FITS data parameters.

How it addresses the challenge:
Astraea bridges the gap between complex astrophysics and human accessibility. It transforms raw, multidimensional astronomical data into an intuitive, real-time interactive visualization, allowing users to seamlessly compare observations over time and track celestial changes.

Why it is important:
While scientific data repositories are often dense and intimidating, Astraea achieves the democratization of space data. By combining robust data processing pipelines with captivating visual storytelling, it empowers both everyday explorers and researchers to engage with the universe meaningfully, making space science truly accessible to all.
details: Astraea is an interactive, web-based celestial exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to address the complexity of analyzing massive multi-epoch infrared observation data from NASA’s SPHEREx mission. Built using a robust technology stack combining Python for backend data extraction and FITS processing alongside Next.js, React, and TypeScript for the frontend, the platform features a dual-mode interface that bridges the gap between complex astrophysics and human accessibility. It offers an artistic, narrative-driven Explorer Mode inspired by cultural and literary motifs, alongside a technical Research Mode that unpacks 102-band spectral analysis, coordinate tracking (RA/DEC), and multi-extension FITS data parameters. By transforming dense, multidimensional astronomical data into an intuitive, real-time interactive visualization, Astraea enables users to effortlessly compare observations over time and track celestial changes. The project uniquely combines rigorous scientific data processing pipelines with captivating visual storytelling, aiming to achieve the democratization of space data and empower both everyday explorers and researchers to engage meaningfully with the universe.
